title: Answer: consciousness is a folk concept whose real referent neuroscience will settle

statements.text: Consciousness, as the folk conceive it, is a theoretical concept like others, not a uniquely hard problem set apart from the rest of the mind. What it picks out, if anything, is to be found by studying the brain.

sources.quote: I propose we get on with the task of seeing how far we get when we address neurobiologically the problems of mental phenomena
